en.description: I am an Embedded Systems Engineer and M.Sc. student at the Technical University of Munich. I enjoy working close to hardware and turning complex ideas into systems that are reliable, practical, and well thought through.

de.description: I am an Embedded Systems Engineer and M.Sc. student at the Technical University of Munich. I enjoy working close to hardware and turning complex ideas into systems that are reliable, practical, and well thought through.

en.description: What I like most about embedded systems is the mix of low-level problem solving, system thinking, and the chance to build something that works dependably in the real world. I also enjoy working with people who care about building solid products with attention to detail. If that sounds like the kind of work you care about too, let's work together!
